title: Walks and open gates at 1612 and 1620 Prairie
items: 1612 Prairie (Goodman) and 1620 Prairie (Law) now have a flagged walk from the sidewalk through the front gate to the steps, where before the lawn ran up to a shut gate.
Their entrance gates now stand open, as the 1612 photograph and both pictures of 1620 show them.
A cinder side walk runs from each south gate back down the side passage to the rear.
